installBody: Open Club Portal straight from your phone's home screen, like an app.
secWhatBody: Two-step sign-in (2FA) protects your account. After your password, you type a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone. Others can't sign in even if they know your password.
secAppHint: Example authenticator apps: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Authy (free).
secOnBody: Each time you sign in, you'll need the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
secOffBody: Your account is protected by your password only.
secPasswordStartHint: To make sure it's really you.
secStep1: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app
secQrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
secManual: Can't scan? Type this key into the app:
secStep2: Type the 6-digit code shown in the app
secCodesBody: If you lose your phone, use one of these codes to sign in. Each code works once. They won't be shown again.
secTurnOffHint: Enter your password to turn off 2FA.
secTurnOffCode: Code from the authenticator app, or a recovery code
secTurnOffCodeHint: Type the 6 digits from the app. No phone? Use one of your recovery codes.
